decision.rule: PRE-REGISTERED before the run. Each of §1.17's sixteen axes is measured on the live client: the engine-source half through the real lifecycle state and package surfaces, the on-screen half by walking a real session's snapshot — the read model every frame draws from. ON-SCREEN is operationalized as: presented by the snapshot as a NAMED READOUT (a needs entry, the age/mood readouts, or the health readout); data that merely rides the snapshot for other consumers (the log, thread signals, ui_hints) is not a readout. INSTRUMENT gate (Phase N's law, O4's hard-gate shape): the eight visible-axis engine dispositions must reproduce the committed M5 survey on exactly seven of eight, with health differing only as absent -> chosen_definition_dr0054 — the decision DR 0054 took AFTER that survey — and any other mismatch raises instead of writing an artifact. The dated correction beside §1.17 is warranted only if the measured split differs from the documented one, and its clauses quote this artifact.
decision.prediction: Recorded before the run: six of the eight documented-visible axes on screen, with happiness and cleanliness absent UPSTREAM of display (DR 0048's two real gaps); stress and grid stability — both documented hidden — surfaced under the accurate labels 'stress' and 'body stability'; the other six hidden axes not surfaced; the instrument matching the committed survey 7/8 with health explained by DR 0054/0055. Whatever the measurement says is what ships.
